title: Water for All
response: Solar-powered pumping, rehabilitated treatment facilities and expanded pipe networks. A 24-month programme for more reliable public water supply.

title: Market traders recovery
response: Set up an independent committee within seven days of taking office to document traders’ losses, assess compensation claims and arrange replacement trading spaces.

title: Education
response: Rehabilitate existing classrooms, assess school safety and address teacher shortages, starting with the schools in greatest need.

title: Steady Power
response: Provide affordable electricity through solar systems and mini-grids for markets, businesses, schools, clinics and rural communities.

title: Agriculture
response: Develop agricultural production, processing and storage across the three senatorial zones, with solar-powered agro-processing hubs.

title: Healthcare
response: Upgrade at least one primary health centre in every ward to provide 24-hour service.

title: Environment
metricLabel: New road infrastructure target for rural LGAs
response: Direct 60% of new road infrastructure towards rural LGAs, with durable farm-to-market roads, bridges and erosion control.

title: Digital economy
response: Establish innovation hubs in Agbani, Nsukka and Oji River, with practical digital skills training and workspaces.

title: Aviation
response: Develop Akanu Ibiam International Airport as an aviation, trade and diaspora gateway.

title: Tourism
response: Develop Enugu’s cultural and natural attractions through heritage conservation and tourism investment.

title: Business and taxation
response: Introduce 12 months of state-level tax relief for eligible registered micro and small businesses, and review duplicative levies.
